```artifact
Feature: Services Offered in and around Padmavathi Hospital

  Scenario: Services offered within a radius of 25 sqkm
    Given the hospital is located at Pincode 500001
    And the radius for services is 25 sqkm
    When a patient registers for services
    Then the system should offer services to the patient

  Scenario: Services offered within a set of specified PinCodes
    Given the hospital is located at Pincode 500001
    And the PinCodes for services are 500001, 500002, 500003
    When a patient registers for services
    Then the system should offer services to the patient

  Scenario: Patients residing in the Zone can only register and apply for Appointments/ Consultation Requests
    Given the patient is residing at Pincode 500004
    When the patient tries to register for services
    Then the system should deny registration

  Scenario: Authorized Chemist per Pincode (24/7 Operations)
    Given the hospital is located at Pincode 500001
    And there is an authorized chemist at Pincode 500001
    When a patient requests a prescription
    Then the system should route the prescription to the chemist

  Scenario: Prescription requests routed to the Chemist after matching the Patient Pincode (from Address) to Chemist Pincode
    Given the patient is residing at Pincode 500001
    And the chemist is located at Pincode 500001
    When a patient requests a prescription
    Then the system should route the prescription to the chemist

  Scenario: Chemist deliver the medicines through Offline delivery and collect payments from Patients
    Given the patient is residing at Pincode 500001
    And the chemist is located at Pincode 500001
    When a patient requests a prescription
    Then the system should deliver the medicines to the patient

  Scenario: Chemist mark the Prescription on completion of delivery
    Given the patient is residing at Pincode 500001
    And the chemist is located at Pincode 500001
    When a patient requests a prescription
    Then the system should mark the prescription as completed

  Scenario: No systemic matching done to figure out efficiency of the Chemist
    Given the patient is residing at Pincode 500001
    And the chemist is located at Pincode 500001
    When a patient requests a prescription
    Then the system should not perform any matching for chemist efficiency

  Scenario: There will be 1 Authorised Laboratory per Pincode or there will be 1 Laboratory for the entire Zone
    Given the hospital is located at Pincode 500001
    And there is an authorized laboratory at Pincode 500001
    When a patient requests a test
    Then the system should route the test to the laboratory

  Scenario Outline: Patients outside the defined zone cannot register
    Given the patient is residing at Pincode 500005
    When the patient tries to register for services
    Then the system should deny registration

    Examples:
      | Pincode |
      | 500005  |
      | 500006  |
      | 500007  |

  Scenario Outline: Patients outside the defined zone cannot apply for Appointments/ Consultation Requests
    Given the patient is residing at Pincode 500005
    When the patient tries to apply for an appointment
    Then the system should deny application

    Examples:
      | Pincode |
      | 500005  |
      | 500006  |
      | 500007  |
```
